run_hotpot_evaluation: run the HotpotQA evaluation script comparing a prediction JSON file against a gold standard JSON file
normalize_answer_text: normalize an answer string by lowercasing, removing articles, punctuation, and fixing whitespace
compute_f1_score: compute the F1 score, precision, and recall between a predicted answer and a ground truth answer
compute_exact_match: compute the exact match score between a predicted answer and a ground truth answer after normalization
evaluate_supporting_facts: evaluate supporting fact predictions against gold supporting facts using set-based precision, recall, and F1
